place.name: Ormaiztegi Viaduct
place.description: The Ormaiztegi Viaduct (Basque: Ormaiztegiko zubibidea, Spanish: Viaducto de Ormaiztegi) is a lattice girder viaduct in Ormaiztegi, Spain that was formerly used by a railroad to link a line from Madrid to Irun. It is now considered a historical monument.
